title: PCH Access: Moomat Ahiko Way On & Off Ramps Closure
description:
Heads up, Santa Monica! Moomat Ahiko Way on and off ramps to Pacific Coast Highway are expected to close for approximately two months, starting as early as Monday, Sept. 28, for work on the Santa Monica Pier Bridge Replacement Project.

The Santa Monica Pier will remain open throughout the closure. Plan ahead, allow extra travel time and follow posted detour, parking and pedestrian signage.

For the latest updates and construction alerts, visit santamonica.gov
transcript_text: Here's a quick heads-up for your next trip into Santa Monica from PCH. Starting as early as Monday, September 28th, the Moomat Ahiko Way on and off-ramp from PCH are expected to close for about 2 months while crews continue to work on the Santa Monica Pier Bridge Replacement Project. Reminder, the pier is still open. Restaurants, shops, and attractions will remain open throughout the closure. Plan ahead, allow extra travel time to follow posted detours, parking, and pedestrian signs. For the latest updates, visit santamonica.gov and sign up for construction alerts.
